data.name: Juyair
data.gender_notes: Juyair is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Juyair is an Arabic name that symbolizes kindness, justice, and compassion. It is a beautiful name that reflects the qualities of a compassionate and fair person. The name Juyair carries the meaning “Kind and just” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Juyair usually hope their child will grow to embody kind and just and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Juyair is derived from the Arabic word 'juya' which means 'high' or 'exalted'. In spiritual context, it signifies being close to Allah and being elevated in one's faith.
data.etymology: Juyair belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Kind and just.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Juyair total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: جُيَيْر
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من الجيد و السرعة في الخير
in_arabic.long_meaning: جُيَيْر هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه المشتق من الجيد و السرعة في الخير و العمل الصالح. و يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و محمودة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: جویئر
in_urdu.meaning: خیر اور خوبی کا سبب بننے والا نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: جویئر ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خیر اور خوبی کا سبب بننے والا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے اور اس کا استعمال جنوبی ایشیاء کے مسلمانوں میں عام ہے۔

in_hindi.name: जुयैर
in_hindi.meaning: ख़ैर और अच्छाई की जड़ होने वाला नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: जुयैर एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है ख़ैर और अच्छाई की जड़ होने वाला। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है और इसका उपयोग पारंपरिक रूप से किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: جویر
in_pashto.meaning: د خیر او نیکۍ سبب ګرځیدونکی نوم
